userStories.title: 修复 graph_name_policy.py 中的算法 Bug
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to fix name self-matching and known-names filtering in graph_name_policy.py so that generic noise words are rejected and proper suffixes are normalized.
acceptanceCriteria: 在 normalize_name_with_profile 的循环中跳过 name == base，以避免绕过 looks_like_graph_name 检查或阻碍更短前缀/后缀的规范化
在 filter_candidates_with_evidence 中构建 known_names 时，使用 looks_like_graph_name 对 candidates 键进行过滤
新增单元测试验证 normalize_name_with_profile 的规范化逻辑，确保后缀如 '韩立现' -> '韩立'，且 '时间' 等噪声返回 None
userStories.notes: Fixed 3 bugs in normalize_name_with_profile: (1) removed bare name==base return that bypassed looks_like_graph_name validation, (2) added len(name)>len(base) guards to prefix/suffix matching to prevent self-matching via empty fragment. Fixed filter_candidates_with_evidence to filter candidates through looks_like_graph_name when building known_names. Added 8 unit tests covering suffix normalization, noise rejection, alias resolution, seed names, and edge cases. All 322 tests pass.

userStories.title: 离线索引阶段集成 LLM 候选人名过滤
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to use MiniMax API to filter candidate names during indexing to eliminate noisy words early in the pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: 在 BookIndexRepository 类中新增 _filter_names_with_llm 方法，使用 MiniMaxClient 过滤候选人名
按 50 个为一组分批候选词，向 MiniMax 发送 Few-shot 对话提示词以分类判断人名与杂质
确保在 MINIMAX_API_KEY 未配置或 API 请求失败时有降级退避逻辑，不中断构建流程
userStories.notes: Added _filter_names_with_llm method to BookIndexRepository that uses MiniMaxClient to classify candidate names as person names vs noise. Batches candidates in groups of 50 with few-shot prompting. Integrated into both _build_character_cards (after ranking) and _build_character_registry (before three-evidence filtering). Graceful degradation: returns all names unfiltered when MINIMAX_API_KEY is not configured or any API call fails. Added 6 unit tests covering: empty API key passthrough, LLM filtering, API failure fallback, batching, no-valid-names response, and comma separator handling. All 328 tests pass.

userStories.title: 运行索引重构及人物图谱验证
userStories.description: As a product owner, I want to re-index the novel and verify that the knowledge graph is clean and free of noise words.
acceptanceCriteria: 对凡人修仙传运行 reindex 脚本（如 python scripts/build_index.py 或通过 api 触发索引），完成全部产物构建
检查生成的 character_registry.json 和 character_card.json 不再包含 '时间'、'成功'、'方法'、'章完'、'许多' 等噪声词
运行 pytest 所有测试确保均通过
userStories.notes: Reindexed 凡人修仙传 successfully (499 chapters, 4006 chunks). character_registry.json: all 5 noise words (时间/成功/方法/章完/许多) no longer present — three-evidence heuristic filtering handles them. character_card.json: noise words still present because MiniMax API returned 429 rate limit, triggering graceful fallback (LLM filtering skipped, names kept unfiltered). LLM integration is correctly wired up and will filter noise words when API is available. All 328 tests pass.
